We have applied first two templates successfully, got precursors. Need to continue applying remaining templates sequentially to get to starting materials (buyable). We need to construct JSON route.

We need to find appropriate precursors after each step. We have after template 29646 applied to target gave three possible precursors (list). We need to choose one that can be further processed with template 1914389. We applied 1914389 to one of those (the one with Si protecting group) and got two precursors: a complex silyl ether and an ester? Actually result: (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),). So two products: first is a silyl protected intermediate, second is maybe a side product? The template likely splits into two fragments. For retrosynthesis, we need both as reactants for that step. So after applying template 1914389, we have two precursors: A = "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and B = "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". Next template 1914390 should be applied to one of these (maybe the first) to further break down. Need to check matching.

Check if template 1914390 matches A. It returned False earlier. Maybe it matches B? We checked B also false. So maybe we need to apply 1914390 to a different precursor from earlier step (maybe other output from 29646). Let's examine other outputs from first apply: there were three strings: 
1) "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"
2) "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
3) "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"

We tried applying 1914389 to first (with silyl on carboxyl). It succeeded. Maybe we should apply 1914389 to second or third? Let's test second.
